payload.name: Extract all participants' preferences from shared-activity statements
payload.description: When a message states a shared activity or preference involving multiple people or pets, extract each participant's attitude (likes, loves, enjoys) before summarizing, especially when storing an event or preference memory.
content: When extracting from a message that describes a shared activity or preference, capture every participant's explicitly stated attitude or role in the candidate content, not just the main subject's plan.
If a pet or other entity is described as enjoying an activity, include that preference in the memory content even when the primary subject is a person.

solves: During extraction, candidates often summarize only the primary speaker's plan and omit other participants' explicitly stated preferences, causing partial memory coverage. This rule applies whenever a message explicitly describes what multiple entities like or enjoy doing together; extract each entity's stated preference as part of the memory content so future queries about any participant can be answered.
